title: Crossroads 5th Anniversary Showcase Set for October 10
content: Crossroads Conservatory turns five this year, and we're celebrating with a showcase at The Phoenix on October 10, 2026, at 6pm. Students from every track will perform, from first-year beginners to our advanced ensemble, with a closing set from a few of us on the faculty. Five years ago this was an idea and a borrowed practice room. Today it's 85 students and eight instructors. Come hear what they've built. Seating is limited; reservation details to follow.
excerpt: Our 5th Anniversary Showcase comes to The Phoenix on Oct 10, 2026.

title: Spring Enrollment Is Open — Lessons and Ensembles
content: Enrollment for private lessons, group theory, and ensembles is open now at crossroadsconservatory.com. We have a few openings on saxophone, piano, and bass before the term fills. New students start with a placement lesson so we can match you to the right instructor and track. Use the interest form and our office will follow up within a day.
excerpt: Spring enrollment is open. A few lesson openings remain.

title: Teaching Improvisation: How I Break Down a Solo
content: Improvising scares a lot of students more than any technical passage. My mentor Frank DeLuca used to tell me: 'sing it before you play it.' In this post I walk through how I introduce soloing to intermediate students at Crossroads — start with the melody, then the chord tones, then the spaces in between. We build a solo one phrase at a time, and we listen back to every take. The goal isn't to sound finished. It's to sound like yourself.
excerpt: How I teach a first solo — from melody to chord tones to space.

title: Summer Jazz Camp for Teens — Planning Notes
content: We're planning our summer jazz camp for teens again, two weeks in July 2027, here at Crossroads. Mornings are theory and ear training, afternoons are combos and a daily masterclass, and we close with a public set. Last year's group surprised everyone, including themselves. This post collects the planning notes — repertoire ideas, guest faculty I'm hoping to bring in, and a returning-family early registration list.
excerpt: Planning the 2027 summer jazz camp for teens at Crossroads.
